acceptedAnswer.text: ACOS is a structured configuration and orchestration layer that turns terminal-based AI tools into full-featured creative operating systems.

mainEntity.name: How does ACOS coordinate multiple agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: It uses specialized agent profiles, role-scoped permission models, and Model Context Protocol servers to hand off tasks between specialist agents.

mainEntity.name: What skills are included with ACOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Over 80 modular skills covering technical architecture, content engineering, SEO schema generation, workflow automation, and brand voice protection.

mainEntity.name: Can ACOS integrate with existing CI/CD pipelines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All ACOS quality checks and workflows can execute via command-line scripts inside standard GitHub Actions or Vercel build steps.

mainEntity.name: How do I start with ACOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clone the repository, configure your local CLAUDE.md and environment tokens, and run the 30-minute quick-start setup.
